Posted November 3, 2007 

Analysis by Richard Cowan  

 

Welcome to MarijuanaNews.com  or welcome back.  

 

MarijuanaNews.com will be ten years old later this month, so there are thousands of articles here dating back to 1997. (There were a few interruptions along the way, one of which was over a year.) 

 

Why MarijuanaNews.com?  

 

MarijuanaNews.com is focused the cannabis issues, medical, hemp, and personal use, but it is inevitably set in the context of the drug war and the global political situation. 

 

There are many excellent anti-prohibitionist websites today, which is one reason that MarijuanaNews.com kept evolving over the years. Today, it has two unique features.  

 

First, its large archives are a record of the changes in the way the issue has been treated or neglected by the media.  One of the oddities of my job is that I spend a lot of time reading things that I disagree with, and I want everyone to know what the prohibitionists are really saying. I quote them at length in context and provide links to their websites. This is not unique to MarijuanaNews, of course. It is the fundamental difference between us and the enemies of freedom.

 

Second, for better or for worse, it reflects my own views, based on decades of writing on the subject. Obviously, I hope you find that useful. "To get understanding" is the conceit of punditry. That is why I made "Freedom has nothing to fear from the truth" the motto of this website to remind everyone, including our own side, that the truth is our first obligation.   

 

The oldest article here, which actually predates the site by eleven years, is HOW THE NARCS CREATED CRACK, and was originally published in the National Review Magazine on December 5, 1986. 


This article has been cited in scholarly journals as the origin of the economics of contraband as applied to "drugs", which I called  "The Iron Law of Prohibition"  the harder the enforcement the harder the drugs.  

 

I was greatly flattered when several obituaries of the late Milton Friedman attributed it to him. (He phoned me when I became National Director of NORML in 1992, and strongly backed our efforts.) 

 

The point is not that I am responsible for the idea, but that I have a responsibility to the idea. The "drugwar" is not just a "failure", but rather a counterproductive fraud that is making all of the problems of governance and public health much worse. It is a moral and economic absurdity. Over the years, I have written follow-up pieces on MarijuanaNews.com, such as this from 2005: Meth and Marijuana. Now: How the Narks Created Crank in Canada. The Iron Law of Drug Prohibition. The Inescapable Economics Of Contraband.  

 

The one constant theme of MarijuanaNews.com has always been Media Criticism and that the best two-word explanation for marijuana prohibition is bad journalism. 

From 1998 see 

Marijuana Prohibition, Media Criticism, Copyrights and the 8th and 9th Commandments. 

and from last month see
The LA Times Ignores the NORML Conference and the Violence All Around Them. There Are None So Blind As Editors Who Dont Want To See. 

The best way to find what you need on the site is to use the Search! function and index pages which are on the right side of every page. 

 

The Chronological Index page is a large file which will be slow to load on dial up but fast on cable or DSL. It has a complete list of all the articles and you might use your browsers "Find" feature (Control F on the Internet Explorer) to look for key words in the titles, but the titles dont have every topic. 

 

There is also a F.A.Q's link that has been here from the beginning and deals with the major questions. The more things change; the more they stay the same. The prohibitionist rarely come up with a new lie. 

 

Of course, Medical Marijuana has always been a major focus.  

For example,
Medical Marijuana Endgame: "So go ahead and die. That would be all right?" "Congress has made that value judgment." Not Really, But The Bush Administration Has. The American People Have Not! 

and from 2000, but still sadly relevant 

California Narks Lie to Justify Disobeying Prop 215. And They Lie About Me In The Process.  

And there are stories that you will not read anywhere else,

such as
The Drug War Is Politics By Other Means: Blackwater Gets Billions to Fight Narco-Terorism. Buying Constituencies for the Drug War. Analysis by Richard Cowan
and 

The Murder of Robin Prosser. An Indictment of Karen Tandy and Motorola By Their Own Words and Standards. 

Perhaps the article that best describes my view on prohibition is this one from 2000: The Theory and Practice of Chaos Analysis By Richard Cowan 


 

And the article that best describes my relationship with cannabis and the marijuana reform movement is My version of Because I got high. By Richard Cowan 

 

On a more practical level, RedAphid.com is helping me reorganize the site to make it easier to use, and widen its appeal.  

 

In the meantime, I need your help. 

 

First and foremost, please spread the word. The purpose of this site has always been to prove that the truth will make us free  in my lifetime. (Im still here and we really are winning, but I am getting older and the narks are getting meaner, so hurry!) 

 

Tell your friends about MarijuanaNews.com and cite it in letters to the editor, etc. 

 

If you are in a position to give financial support, it would be greatly appreciated. Hence the lovely PayPal button. (If you would prefer an older method, email me and I will send you my snail mail address.) 

 

You may notice that there are no Google Adsense ads, because MarijuanaNews.com is about illegal drugs. We are going to be seeking advertising support from the cannabis industries, but freedom really isnt free, so please do what you can. 

(We need a new laptop, and video and still cameras, and food and other luxuries.) 

 

This Users Guide will be updated from time to time and the site will be updated several times a week, so check back often. 

 

And please let me know what you think. 

 

Sincerely, 

Richard Cowan  

Cowan@MarijuanaNews.com
